verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no native sync to QuickBooks, NetSuite, or Xero. Clara offers API building blocks instead: you can pull transactions, attach GL codes or cost centers via labels, and build your own custom connectors, which the docs pitch for SAP, Oracle, or proprietary systems. Constructing a connector yourself is a developer building block, not the product delivering the sync.

support.subject: As a finance lead, transactions sync to QuickBooks, NetSuite, or Xero with GL account, class, and department mappings I control
